meta.title: Old Venetian Port of Chania – Chania, Greece
meta.description: Complete travel guide to the Old Venetian Port of Chania. Learn about this historic landmark, including location, history, visiting information, and visitor reviews.

intro.title: Discover Old Venetian Port of Chania
intro.description: The Old Venetian Port of Chania is one of the most iconic landmarks in Crete, Greece. Built during the Venetian period (1204-1669), it features picturesque architecture, colorful buildings, and a historic lighthouse. This charming harbor is the heart of Chania's old town and a must-visit destination for travelers.

visitGuide.title: Visit Tips
items: Best visited in early morning or late afternoon to avoid crowds.
Sunset is the most magical time to enjoy the harbor views.
Try local seafood at the waterfront restaurants.
Bring a camera for stunning photography opportunities.

sections.title: History & Construction
sections.content: The Old Venetian Port was constructed during the Venetian rule of Crete (1204-1669). It served as a vital trading hub in the Mediterranean. The port was expanded and fortified to protect against pirates and rival powers.

sections.title: The Egyptian Lighthouse
sections.content: The iconic lighthouse at the entrance of the port was built in the 16th century by the Venetians and later restructured by the Egyptians in the 19th century. It is one of the oldest lighthouses in the world.

sections.title: Architecture & Preservation
sections.content: The port area features well-preserved Venetian and Ottoman architecture. The buildings now house restaurants, cafes, and shops, creating a vibrant atmosphere that blends history with modern life.

sections.title: Cultural Significance
sections.content: The Old Port is the cultural and historical center of Chania. It hosts various festivals, events, and is a symbol of the city's diverse heritage spanning Venetian, Ottoman, and Greek periods.

transport.title: How to Get Here
transport.fromCenterDesc: Distance of about 15km from Chania International Airport. Take a taxi or rental car to the old port.
transport.fromStationDesc: Local buses connect the airport and city center to the old town area.
transport.fromHotelDesc: Most hotels in Chania old town are within walking distance to the port.
transport.walkingDesc: The port is pedestrian-friendly with scenic walking paths.
transport.drivingDesc: Parking available in nearby public parking areas.

route.title: Recommended Route
route.overview: Explore the historic harbor and its surroundings.
steps: Start from the Venetian Harbor entrance
Visit the Egyptian Lighthouse at the breakwater
Enjoy dining at a waterfront restaurant
